that now, even tendemess —
arrives sounding like a waming.
i confuse care with control,
silence with leaving,
and every “stay”
feels temporary somehow.
people call it overthinking,
but they never saw
how gently betrayal can speak,
how softly abandonment enters
before it ruins the house.
so now
when someone loves me right,
i keep searching their hands
for hidden storms.
and the cruelest part is—
i still crave love
with the same heart
that no longer knows
how to trust it.
~ Mohit Yenugwor
